content.short: Ethplorer is an Ethereum blockchain explorer.
content.description: Ethplorer is an Ethereum blockchain explorer that lets users view information about Ethereum tokens and manage their ERC20 holdings without logging into their wallet. It also provides a developer API to retrieve data on Ethereum tokens, transaction histories, balances, addresses, and contracts, enabling programmatic access to token information on the Ethereum network and supporting developers who build tools and services around token data.

resources.title: Ethereum Rich List: Where Capital Really Resides
resources.tldr: Aggregating holdings by USD value rather than by token changes the picture considerably. The first half of a two-part look at concentration.

resources.title: Ethereum Rich List: How Capital Moves and Where Risks Emerge
resources.tldr: The follow-up, tracking movement between those holders over time. Concentration is one thing; correlated movement is the part that matters for risk.
